# ALKALOIDS ANALYSIS

# 1. Initial Setup and Package Loading

```{r Initialize working environment}

# Function to silently load packages without warnings or messages
load_packages <- function(pkgs) {
  invisible(lapply(pkgs, function(pkg) {
      suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
          if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
            stop(paste("❌ Package not found:", pkg), call. = FALSE)
          }))
    }))
}

# Vector of required packages
packages_needed <- c("tidyverse", "ggplot2", "grid", "gtable", "gridExtra",
                     "ggtext", "gridtext")

# Call the function to load them
load_packages(packages_needed)

# Print the information of the working session in order to ensure reproducibility
sessionInfo()

```


```{r Create working directory}

# NOTE: This script is expected to run without modifications if the repository
# is downloaded with its original folder structure from GitHub. If any file or
# directory paths are changed, the corresponding pathways in the script must be
# updated accordingly.

# Create directory within the file system to save the results of the analyses
dir.create("../data/outputs_script_3", recursive = TRUE, 
           showWarnings = FALSE)

```


# 2. Process the datasets and build both heatmaps

## 2.1 Load the datasets

```{r Data loading and reshaping}

# Load datasets
alkaloid_pcr <- read.table("../data/alkaloids_PCR.csv",
                           sep = ";", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

alkaloid_qual <- read.table("../data/alkaloids_qualitative.csv",
                            sep = ";", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

alkaloid_quant <- read.table("../data/alkaloids_quantitative.csv",
                             sep = ";", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)


# Remove accidental leading/trailing spaces from column names
colnames(alkaloid_pcr) <- trimws(colnames(alkaloid_pcr))
colnames(alkaloid_qual) <- trimws(colnames(alkaloid_qual))
colnames(alkaloid_quant) <- trimws(colnames(alkaloid_quant))


# Remove control samples
alkaloid_pcr <- alkaloid_pcr %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("_C$", SampleID))

alkaloid_qual <- alkaloid_qual %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("_C$", SampleID))

alkaloid_quant <- alkaloid_quant %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("_C$", SampleID))


# Define common sample order
stopifnot(identical(alkaloid_pcr$SampleID, alkaloid_qual$SampleID),
          identical(alkaloid_pcr$SampleID, alkaloid_quant$SampleID))
common_sample_order <- alkaloid_qual$SampleID


# Display only sample numbers (1–5)
sample_number_labels <- sub("^.*_", "", common_sample_order)
names(sample_number_labels) <- common_sample_order


# Define host/endophyte groups
host_groups <- data.frame(Group = c("**Fyves** (*E. festucae*)",
                                    "**Froth** (*E. festucae*)",
                                    "**Fnigr** (*E. festucae*)",
                                    "**Fprui** (*E. festucae*)",
                                    "**Farun** (*E. coenophiala*)"),
                          Start = c(1, 6, 11, 16, 21),
                          End = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25))

host_vertical_lines <- c(5.5, 10.5, 15.5, 20.5)

```


## 2.2 Create the PCR heatmap

```{r Constructing and exporting the PCR genotyping panel}

# Prepare PCR data
gene_order <- c("Per", "PerRed", "DmaW", "lpsA", "lolC", "idtG")

alkaloid_pcr_lng <- alkaloid_pcr %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(gene_order),
                      names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SampleID = factor(SampleID, levels = common_sample_order),
                Gene = factor(Gene, levels = rev(gene_order)),
                Value = factor(Value, levels = c("-", "+")))


# Define PCR labels
gene_labels <- c("Per" = "*ppzA*", "PerRed" = "*per red*", "DmaW" = "*dmaW*",
                 "lpsA" = "*lpsA*", "lolC" = "*lolC*", "idtG" = "*idtG*")


# Define PCR pathway groups
pcr_pathway_groups <- data.frame(Group = c("PER", "EA", "LOL", "IDT"),
                                 Start = c(1, 3, 5, 6),
                                 End = c(2, 4, 5, 6))
n_pcr_rows <- length(gene_order)
pcr_horizontal_lines <- n_pcr_rows - head(pcr_pathway_groups$End, -1) + 0.5


# Construct panel A
heatmap_pcr <- ggplot(alkaloid_pcr_lng, aes(x = SampleID, y = Gene)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "white", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = host_vertical_lines, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pcr_horizontal_lines, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Value, colour = Value), size = 4.8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("+" = "#2E8B57", "-" = "#8B0000"), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", limits = common_sample_order,
                   labels = sample_number_labels, drop = FALSE,
                   expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(gene_order), labels = gene_labels,
                   drop = FALSE, expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "A") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 9, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5,
                                       vjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)),
        axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 5)),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        plot.tag.position = c(0, 0.96),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 4, b = 2, l = 15))

```

\newpage

## 2.2 Create the chemical heatmap

```{r Constructing and exporting the chemical (qualitative) panel}

# Define compound order
# Explicitly exclude all metadata columns
meta_cols_qual <- c("Hostsp", "IndividualID", "SampleID", "E")

compound_order <- setdiff(colnames(alkaloid_qual), meta_cols_qual)

# Safety check: IndividualID must never enter the heatmap
stopifnot(!"IndividualID" %in% compound_order)


# Reshape qualitative data
alkaloid_qual_lng <- alkaloid_qual %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(compound_order),
                      names_to = "Compound", values_to = "Value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SampleID = factor(SampleID, levels = common_sample_order),
                Compound = factor(Compound, levels = rev(compound_order)),
                Value = factor(Value, levels = c("NO", "TRACES", "YES")))


# Prepare quantitative data
alkaloid_quant <- alkaloid_quant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Peramine = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Peramine_[mg/kg]`, 
                                          fixed = TRUE)),
                Ergovaline = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Ergovaline_[mg/kg]`, 
                                            fixed = TRUE)))

alkaloid_quant_lng <- alkaloid_quant %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Peramine, Ergovaline) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Peramine, Ergovaline),
                      names_to = "Compound", values_to = "Concentration")


# Add quantitative values
alkaloid_qual_lng <- alkaloid_qual_lng %>%
  dplyr::left_join(alkaloid_quant_lng, by = c("SampleID", "Compound")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(concentration_label = dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(Concentration) ~ "",
    Concentration == 0 ~ "",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", Concentration)))


# Define compound labels
compound_labels <- c(
  "PPZ-2a" = "PPZ-2a",
  "Peramine" = "Peramine (mg/kg)",
  "Chanoclavine" = "Chanoclavine",
  "Ergine" = "Ergine",
  "Ergovaline" = "Ergovaline (mg/kg)",
  "N-acetylnorloline" = "N-acetylnorloline",
  "N-acetylloline" = "N-acetylloline",
  "N-formylloline" = "N-formylloline",
  "N-methylloline" = "N-methylloline",
  "Loline" = "Loline",
  "Emindole_SB" = "Emindole SB",
  "Paspaline" = "Paspaline",
  "13-Desoxypaxilline_RT28.3" = "13-Desoxypaxilline RT28.3",
  "Paxilline" = "Paxilline",
  "Paxilline_IsomerRT30.7" = "Paxilline RT30.7",
  "Paxitriol_Isomer" = "Paxitriol Isomer",
  "Terpendole_C" = "Terpendole C",
  "Terpendole_E" = "Terpendole E",
  "Terpendole_I" = "Terpendole I",
  "Terpendole_I_Isomer_RT30.7" = "Terpendole I RT30.7",
  "Terpendole_I_Isomer_RT31.2" = "Terpendole I RT31.2",
  "Terpendole_J" = "Terpendole J",
  "Lolitrem_B" = "Lolitrem B")

# Use the original column name if a compound has no custom label
missing_labels <- setdiff(compound_order, names(compound_labels))
compound_labels <- c(compound_labels, stats::setNames(missing_labels, missing_labels))


# Define chemical pathway groups
compound_pathway <- c(
  "PPZ-2a" = "PER",
  "Peramine" = "PER",
  "Chanoclavine" = "EA",
  "Ergine" = "EA",
  "Ergovaline" = "EA",
  "N-acetylnorloline" = "LOL",
  "N-acetylloline" = "LOL",
  "N-formylloline" = "LOL",
  "N-methylloline" = "LOL",
  "Loline" = "LOL",
  "Emindole_SB" = "IDT",
  "Paspaline" = "IDT",
  "13-Desoxypaxilline_RT28.3" = "IDT",
  "Paxilline" = "IDT",
  "Paxilline_IsomerRT30.7" = "IDT",
  "Paxitriol_Isomer" = "IDT",
  "Terpendole_C" = "IDT",
  "Terpendole_E" = "IDT",
  "Terpendole_I" = "IDT",
  "Terpendole_I_Isomer_RT30.7" = "IDT",
  "Terpendole_I_Isomer_RT31.2" = "IDT",
  "Terpendole_J" = "IDT",
  "Lolitrem_B" = "IDT")

qual_pathway_groups <- tibble::tibble(
  Compound = compound_order,
  Group = unname(compound_pathway[compound_order])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Start = min(match(Compound, compound_order)),
                   End = max(match(Compound, compound_order)),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("PER", "EA", "LOL", "IDT"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = as.character(Group))

n_qual_rows <- length(compound_order)

qual_horizontal_lines <- n_qual_rows -
  head(qual_pathway_groups$End, -1) + 0.5


# Define colours
cols_heatmap <- c("NO" = "#D9D9D9", "TRACES" = "#F0C419", "YES" = "#0072B4")


# Construct panel B
heatmap_qual <- ggplot(alkaloid_qual_lng,
                       aes(x = SampleID, y = Compound, fill = Value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = host_vertical_lines, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = qual_horizontal_lines, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = concentration_label), colour = "white",
            size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_heatmap, breaks = c("NO", "TRACES", "YES"),
                    drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", limits = common_sample_order,
                   labels = sample_number_labels, drop = FALSE,
                   expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(compound_order), labels = compound_labels,
                   drop = FALSE, expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "B") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5,
                                       vjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 5)),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        plot.tag.position = c(0, 0.99),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 4, b = 2, l = 15))

```

# 3. Build final summary figure (both pannels)

```{r Build final figure alkaloids}

# Combine panels
# Convert panels to gtable objects
grob_pcr <- ggplotGrob(heatmap_pcr)
grob_qual <- ggplotGrob(heatmap_qual)

stopifnot(length(grob_pcr$widths) == length(grob_qual$widths))

common_widths <- grid::unit.pmax(grob_pcr$widths, grob_qual$widths)
grob_pcr$widths <- common_widths
grob_qual$widths <- common_widths


# Set cell height
cell_height <- grid::unit(5, "mm")

pcr_panel_row <- unique(grob_pcr$layout$t[grob_pcr$layout$name == "panel"])
qual_panel_row <- unique(grob_qual$layout$t[grob_qual$layout$name == "panel"])

grob_pcr$heights[pcr_panel_row] <- n_pcr_rows * cell_height
grob_qual$heights[qual_panel_row] <- n_qual_rows * cell_height


# Create host group annotations
make_host_grob <- function(host_groups, n_samples, show_labels = TRUE) {

  host_elements <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(host_groups))) {

    xmin <- (host_groups$Start[i] - 1) / n_samples
    xmax <- host_groups$End[i] / n_samples
    xmid <- mean(c(xmin, xmax))

    # Horizontal group bar
    host_elements[[length(host_elements) + 1]] <-
      grid::segmentsGrob(x0 = grid::unit(xmin + 0.008, "npc"),
                         x1 = grid::unit(xmax - 0.008, "npc"),
                         y0 = grid::unit(0.18, "npc"),
                         y1 = grid::unit(0.18, "npc"),
                         gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5))

    # Group name, used only in panel A
    if (show_labels) {
      host_elements[[length(host_elements) + 1]] <-
        gridtext::richtext_grob(text = host_groups$Group[i],
                                x = grid::unit(xmid, "npc"),
                                y = grid::unit(0.70, "npc"),
                                hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
                                gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12),
                                box_gp = grid::gpar(col = NA))
    }
  }

  grid::grobTree(children = do.call(grid::gList, host_elements))
}


# Panel A: bars and species names
host_grob_A <- make_host_grob(host_groups = host_groups,
                              n_samples = length(common_sample_order),
                              show_labels = TRUE)

# Panel B: bars only
host_grob_B <- make_host_grob(host_groups = host_groups,
                              n_samples = length(common_sample_order),
                              show_labels = FALSE)


# Create pathway annotations
make_pathway_grob <- function(pathway_groups, n_rows) {

  pathway_elements <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pathway_groups))) {

    ytop <- 1 - ((pathway_groups$Start[i] - 1) / n_rows)
    ybottom <- 1 - (pathway_groups$End[i] / n_rows)
    ymid <- mean(c(ytop, ybottom))

    pathway_elements[[length(pathway_elements) + 1]] <-
      grid::textGrob(label = pathway_groups$Group[i],
                     x = grid::unit(0.25, "npc"),
                     y = grid::unit(ymid, "npc"),
                     just = "centre",
                     gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"))

    pathway_elements[[length(pathway_elements) + 1]] <-
      grid::segmentsGrob(x0 = grid::unit(0.72, "npc"),
                         x1 = grid::unit(0.72, "npc"),
                         y0 = grid::unit(ybottom + 0.02, "npc"),
                         y1 = grid::unit(ytop - 0.02, "npc"),
                         gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.8))
  }

  grid::grobTree(children = do.call(grid::gList, pathway_elements))
}

pcr_pathway_grob <- make_pathway_grob(pathway_groups = pcr_pathway_groups,
                                      n_rows = n_pcr_rows)

qual_pathway_grob <- make_pathway_grob(pathway_groups = qual_pathway_groups,
                                       n_rows = n_qual_rows)


# Create PCR legend
pcr_legend_grob <- grid::grobTree(
  grid::rectGrob(x = unit(0.40, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 width = unit(4, "mm"), height = unit(4, "mm"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "grey40")),

  grid::textGrob("+", x = unit(0.40, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 gp = gpar(col = "#2E8B57", fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")),

  grid::textGrob("PCR positive", x = unit(0.42, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)),

  grid::rectGrob(x = unit(0.57, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 width = unit(4, "mm"), height = unit(4, "mm"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "grey40")),

  grid::textGrob("−", x = unit(0.57, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 gp = gpar(col = "#8B0000", fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")),

  grid::textGrob("PCR negative", x = unit(0.59, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)))


# Create chemical legend
qual_legend_grob <- grid::grobTree(
  grid::rectGrob(x = unit(0.38, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 width = unit(4, "mm"), height = unit(4, "mm"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = "#0072B4", col = "black")),

  grid::textGrob("Presence", x = unit(0.40, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)),

  grid::rectGrob(x = unit(0.52, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 width = unit(4, "mm"), height = unit(4, "mm"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = "#F0C419", col = "black")),

  grid::textGrob("Traces", x = unit(0.54, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)),

  grid::rectGrob(x = unit(0.64, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 width = unit(4, "mm"), height = unit(4, "mm"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = "#D9D9D9", col = "black")),

  grid::textGrob("Absence", x = unit(0.66, "npc"), y = unit(0.50, "npc"),
                 just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)))


# Add annotations to each panel
decorate_heatmap_gtable <- function(plot_grob, pathway_annotation,
                                    legend_annotation, host_annotation = NULL,
                                    pathway_width = unit(17, "mm"),
                                    host_height = unit(11, "mm"),
                                    legend_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                                    legend_height = unit(7, "mm")) {

  # Add pathway annotation to the left
  axis_l_col <- min(plot_grob$layout$l[grepl("^axis-l", plot_grob$layout$name)])
  
  plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(plot_grob, widths = pathway_width,
                                       pos = axis_l_col - 1)
  pathway_col <- axis_l_col
  
  panel_row <- unique(plot_grob$layout$t[plot_grob$layout$name == "panel"])
  
  plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(plot_grob, grobs = pathway_annotation,
                                       t = panel_row, l = pathway_col, clip = "off")

  # Add group bars above sample numbers
  if (!is.null(host_annotation)) {

    axis_t_row <- min(plot_grob$layout$t[grepl("^axis-t", plot_grob$layout$name)])
    
    plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(plot_grob, heights = host_height,
                                         pos = axis_t_row - 1)

    panel_col <- unique(plot_grob$layout$l[plot_grob$layout$name == "panel"])

    plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(plot_grob, grobs = host_annotation,
                                         t = axis_t_row, l = panel_col,
                                         clip = "off")
  }

  # Add legend below the panel
  plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(plot_grob, heights = legend_gap,
                                       pos = nrow(plot_grob))

  plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(plot_grob, heights = legend_height,
                                       pos = nrow(plot_grob))

  panel_col <- unique(plot_grob$layout$l[plot_grob$layout$name == "panel"])

  plot_grob <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(plot_grob, grobs = legend_annotation,
                                       t = nrow(plot_grob), l = panel_col,
                                       clip = "off")
  plot_grob
}


# Decorate both panels
grob_pcr <- decorate_heatmap_gtable(plot_grob = grob_pcr,
                                    pathway_annotation = pcr_pathway_grob,
                                    legend_annotation = pcr_legend_grob,
                                    host_annotation = host_grob_A)

grob_qual <- decorate_heatmap_gtable(plot_grob = grob_qual,
                                     pathway_annotation = qual_pathway_grob,
                                     legend_annotation = qual_legend_grob,
                                     host_annotation = host_grob_A)


# Match final panel widths
common_decorated_widths <- grid::unit.pmax(grob_pcr$widths, grob_qual$widths)

grob_pcr$widths <- common_decorated_widths
grob_qual$widths <- common_decorated_widths


# Combine panels A and B
panel_gap <- grid::unit(4, "mm")

pcr_total_height <- sum(grob_pcr$heights)
qual_total_height <- sum(grob_qual$heights)

alkaloid_heatmap_combined <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  grob_pcr,
  grid::nullGrob(),
  grob_qual,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = grid::unit.c(pcr_total_height, panel_gap, qual_total_height))

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(alkaloid_heatmap_combined)


# Export final figure
out_dir_heat <- "../data/outputs_script_3/"

ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_heat, "Alkaloids_figure.pdf"),
       plot = alkaloid_heatmap_combined, device = grDevices::pdf,
       width = 31, height = 22, units = "cm", bg = "white")

ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_heat, "Alkaloids_figure.svg"),
       plot = alkaloid_heatmap_combined, device = "svg",
       width = 31, height = 20.6, units = "cm", bg = "white")

```
